close_reason: Skoll v0.1.292 already installed at ~/.local/bin/skoll. fenrir repo at ~/GIT/fenrir. Dry-run confirms adaptive auto-detection works on PKIX workspace (detected crate-pkix, Rust/Python/Shell, correct directory structure).
description: Clone github.com/wolfSSL/fenrir into ~/GIT/fenrir and run ./skoll/install.sh to symlink skoll into ~/.local/bin. Prerequisites: claude CLI on PATH, git, python3, jinja2, pyyaml. Verify install with 'skoll --version'. Dry-run 'skoll security --dry-run' from ~/PROJECT/PKIX to confirm adaptive auto-detection works on a non-wolfSSL project.
title: Install Skoll CLI from wolfSSL/fenrir
